reviews.review:
I killed God.

And all I got was a lousy "Campaign 10% complete" achievement.

Great game.

Buggy, unbalanced, overtuned mess of a game. Every class-specific ability is complete garbage - the ranger's dash starts off slower than walking speed, and has stupidly high end lag for no good f@&king reason. Air raiders are obsolete because rangers can do everything they can besides calling in airstrikes, plus more. Fencers are sitting ducks that can barely do any damage because they decided to make all of their weapons (and the class itself) way too slow to actually get any good dps output on anything...

Plus, most of the weapons are just worse versions of each other, meaning your options for loadout are "dogs#!t" and "worse than dogs#!t." Why is there a version of the grenade launcher that uses timed explosives instead of impact explosives, for example? Impact is OBJECTIVELY better because it means you can hit anything on the map from anywhere as long as you can aim. Having a timer just means you can't hit things from further, and the explosives never go off when you actually need them to. What the h&!l is the point of that?? I'm almost convinced an AI generated this game, with how awful the design of this is.

It does have strong points... mainly in spectacle, and in the fact that you can play with friends. But for a steep asking price of $60, those are a moot point. Go play any other team-based pve shooter than this if you know what's good for you.

Definitely not worth 60 dollars. Get EDF4.1 if you want to know what it's about, this is essentially the same game with slightly better graphics and different missions.

That said, if you overlook all the reused assets and triple-A price tag, the game still might be worth it for you on meme value alone.

The best part of this game for me by far is the english VAs. The story is nonsensical and completely insane, and the voice-over is even more so. It feels like the localization team put the lines through google translate and tried to read it out with gruff soldiery voices and it's hilarious. It's definitely one of those 'so bad it's good' games. If you know that coming in and are willing to shill out the money for it, this game will probably be worth it.
EDF 4+1, more of the same, exactly what I wanted.
